Supreme Court Denies Bail to Former Punjab DGP

The Supreme Court has denied bail to former Punjab Director General of Police (DGP) Harcharan Singh Bhullar. The court remarked that the case was "100% rejectable." Bhullar had sought bail, but the court did not grant him relief. The specific details of the case for which bail was sought were not provided in the coverage.
